evidence.description:
POV Wealth 👋 tells original, second-person stories about money. You step into the life of an ordinary person, a bus driver 🚌, a preschool teacher 🍎, an elevator mechanic 🔧, and face the real financial decisions that come with it: taxes, credit, mortgages, investing, family and fear. 💭

Every story is written for this channel. ✍️ The characters and events are fictional. The money rules inside them are real 📈, such as how credit scores are built, how an LLC keeps your name off a public deed, and what a municipal bond actually earns.

New story every day or two 🎬. For entertainment and education only, not financial, tax, legal or investment advice. Subscribe and see where your own story could go. 💫
